title: A Renewed Chapter on the Strikes: The Capesize Pacific in Focus
section_path: A Renewed Chapter on the Strikes: The Capesize Pacific in Focus
section_path_text: A Renewed Chapter on the Strikes: The Capesize Pacific in Focus
summary:
Main
Published -August 2026 · Market data as of 31 July / 1 August 2026
August opens with a renewed chapter on the Port Hedland strikes. Using AXS Dry Insights, we review the Capesize Pacific - the flow of iron-ore shipments and the ballasters map - to gauge the impact on today's spot market. By Maria Bertzeletou · Senior Market Analyst
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-08-03 153426.png | assets/2026-08-03_a-renewed-chapter-on-the-strikes-the-capesize-pacific-in-focus_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_3884fd081b19.png
THE RENEWED CHAPTER
August has opened where July left off.
